module: Flowgraph node "ConvertUnit" (category repeat_instant): converts an SI value to the player's preferred unit (UI setting) using translateDistance or translateVelocity. Inputs: "value", "velocity" (speed instead of distance), "big" (large unit: km, mi, h), "format" (default '%0.2f%s'). Outputs: "value" (converted number), "unit" (string) and "full" (formatted value+unit, computed only if the pin is used).
notes: The input pin and the output pin are both named "value" (different directions).

work.desc: Converts pinIn.value and writes value, unit and (if the pin is connected) full via string.format.
